{{recipe}}

'''Stuffed burgers''' are gaining popularity because you don't really know what you're gonna bite down on.

== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] ground [[Cookbook:Beef#Chuck|chuck]] (80/20 fat ratio)
* 4 slices crisp-cooked [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]], crumbled
* 4 slices [[Cookbook:Monterey Jack Cheese|pepper jack cheese]], torn
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. large [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], finely [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 3 tbsp shredded [[Cookbook:Monterey Jack Cheese|Monterrey Jack cheese]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
* 2 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], smashed and [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* 3 tbsp unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 4 hamburger buns, split and toasted
* Melted butter

== Procedure ==
#Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]] over medium high heat. Add garlic and onion, and cook until garlic is golden.
#Combine cheeses, bacon, cooked onion and garlic, and butter. Set aside.
#Form meat into 8 equal patties. Make an indentation into the middle of each patty and place a dollop of cheese mixture into dent. Place 1 patty on top of each other, stuffing side down, and push down until patty is about ¾ inch thick. Set aside while you heat your trusty charcoal [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]] (not with that solvent stuff).
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] patties with olive oil and season liberally on both sides with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Set down on grill and cook, turning often, until instant-read [[Cookbook:Thermometer|thermometer]] inserted into the meat, not the stuffing, reads desired temperature (at least 160°F).
#Brush the cut side of each bun with melted butter. Place a patty on top of a bottom half of a bun and top with a top half of a bun. Serve warm.

steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add garlic and onion, and cook until garlic is golden.
Combine cheeses, bacon, cooked onion and garlic, and butter. Set aside.

Form meat into 8 equal patties. Make an indentation into the middle of each patty and place a dollop of cheese mixture into dent. Place 1 patty on top of each other, stuffing side down, and push down until patty is about ¾ inch thick. Set aside while you heat your trusty charcoal grill (not with that solvent stuff).

Brush patties with olive oil and season liberally on both sides with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Set down on grill and cook, turning often, until instant-read thermometer inserted into the meat, not the stuffing, reads desired temperature (at least 160°F).
Brush the cut side of each bun with melted butter. Place a patty on top of a bottom half of a bun and top with a top half of a bun. Serve warm.
